name: Miska
source: Astaroth's servant. Compared to Jilliola, Miska has a bright elder sister personality. Although she treats demonkind warmly, her hatred of humans are not inferior to Jilliola's, and if it wasn't for Astaroth she would be happily torturing the captured heroines.
